Sure! I’ll walk you through setting a quick reminder so you don’t forget your Netflix subscription renewal on **March 27**. Pick whichever method works best for you: --- ### 📅 Option 1 – Phone Reminder (iOS / Android) | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | iPhone/iPad | 1️⃣ Open *Reminders*.
2️⃣ Tap “+ New List” → name it “Subscriptions”.
3️⃣ Add new reminder titled “Netflix Subscription Renewal.”
4️⃣ Set due date to **Mar 27**, time to whatever suits you.
5️⃣ Toggle “Alert at Time” & choose “At time of event.” | | Android | 1️⃣ Open Google Keep or Clock app.
2️⃣ Create a new note/reminder called “Netflix Subscription Renewal.”
3️⃣ Choose “Set reminder” → pick Mar 27 and desired time.
4️⃣ Save. | --- ### ⏰ Option 2 – Digital Assistant (Siri / Google Assistant) - **Siri:** Say “Hey Siri, remind me to renew my Netflix subscription on March 27 at 9 AM.” - **Google Assistant:** Say “Ok Google, remind me to check my Netflix subscription on March 27.” Both will pop up as a notification on the day/time you specified. --- ### 🗓️ Option 3 – Online Calendar (Google Calendar / Microsoft Outlook) #### Google Calendar 1. Go to [calendar.google.com](https://calendar.google.com). 2. Click “Create” ➜ “Event.” 3. Title: `Renew Netflix Subscription`. 4. Date: **March 27**. 5. Time: e.g., 10 AM (or leave blank for all‑day). 6. Under “Add notifications,” select “Notification” → “30 minutes before” (or however far ahead you’d like). 7. Hit “Save”. #### Outlook Calendar 1. In Outlook, click “New Appointment.” 2. Subject: `Netflix Subscription Renewal`. 3. Start/End dates: **March 27**. 4. Set reminder (e.g., 15 min prior). 5. Save & Close. --- ### 💡 Bonus Tips - If you’re worried about forgetting entirely, consider adding a recurring yearly reminder—just change the recurrence rule to “Yearly”. - You can attach a link to your Netflix account page inside the reminder/event description for easy access when the alert pops up. Let me know which option feels most convenient—or if you’d like help automating it via a script or integration!
